vp1105018.title: PORTER Yoshida TANKER 2 Layer Shoulder Bag Black Orange Nylon
vp1105018.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vp1105018.details: PORTER TANKER shoulder bag in black nylon with a bright orange quilted lining, listed as a 2-layer model, with a zipper main compartment, two snap pockets on the front and metal triangle rings for a shoulder strap. The size is listed as about 27 cm wide, 17 cm high and 6 to 7 cm deep. Photo 1 shows the front with the two front pockets and the worn PORTER tag at the lower right, photo 2 shows the back, and photos 3 to 5 show the bag opened with the orange lining, the inside pockets and the inside label. Photo 6 shows the top of the bag, photos 7 and 8 show an orange quilted panel with black trim and snaps laid flat, and photo 9 shows the front pockets with their zippers. Photo 10 is a close-up of the PORTER woven tag on the front, which is worn and frayed, photo 11 shows the inside label reading PORTER, YOSHIDA & CO., LTD., MADE IN JAPAN, and photos 12 to 15 show the sides and the metal strap rings and the strap attachment areas. Photo 16 shows the two zipper pulls stamped PORTER with worn paint. Photo 17 shows a black shoulder strap with swivel hooks, which is a third-party strap and not the original PORTER strap. Condition: pre-owned. Scuffs are listed over the whole bag from long use, the paint is worn off the zipper pulls, and the attachment points of the strap are damaged, as listed and as shown in the photos. The inside is listed as fairly clean. The original shoulder strap is lost, and a third-party shoulder strap shown in photo 17 is included. Included: the bag and the third-party shoulder strap. Please check all photos for the exact condition.
vp1105018.why: A pre-owned black PORTER TANKER 2-layer shoulder bag with an orange lining, heavily used, with a third-party shoulder strap instead of the original.
vp1105018.perfect: Fans of PORTER TANKER who want a black and orange shoulder bag and accept the heavy wear, the worn strap attachments and the third-party strap.
vp1105018.exp: A pre-owned PORTER TANKER shoulder bag in the condition described above, carefully packed and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vp1105018.cd: Pre-owned with signs of heavy use. Scuffs are listed over the whole bag, the paint is worn off the zipper pulls, and the attachment points of the shoulder strap are damaged. The inside is listed as fairly clean. The original shoulder strap is lost; a third-party shoulder strap is included. The size is listed as about 27 cm wide, 17 cm high and 6 to 7 cm deep. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
